  // START KEVIN CAA WIZARD SECTION KtCourseGuardQt QT UPDATE INFORS

  // clang-format off

  // 1, Selected_Spec, field widget,NO ACTION, QListWidget (Not Support),1

  // 2, Axis_Vector, Qt vector
  parameter->Axis_Vector.SetX(dialogMore->doubleSpinBoxAxisVectorX->value() * 1000.0);
  parameter->Axis_Vector.SetY(dialogMore->doubleSpinBoxAxisVectorY->value() * 1000.0);
  parameter->Axis_Vector.SetZ(dialogMore->doubleSpinBoxAxisVectorZ->value() * 1000.0);

  // 3, Float_Values, legacy asymmetric list
  parameter->Float_Values[0] = ui->doubleSpinBoxFloatValues0->value();
  parameter->Float_Values[1] = ui->doubleSpinBoxFloatValues1->value();

  // 4, Count, round to integer
  parameter->Count = Kt::round(ui->doubleSpinBoxCount->value()); //round to int

  // 5, Number, integer spinner
  parameter->Number = ui->spinBoxNumber->value();

  // 6, Flags, bit flags
  parameter->Flags=0;
  if (ui->checkBoxFlags0->isChecked()) { parameter->Flags = parameter->Flags | (1<<0); }
  if (ui->checkBoxFlags1->isChecked()) { parameter->Flags = parameter->Flags | (1<<1); }

  // 7, Mode, enum radio
  parameter->Mode = 0;//默认值0
  if (ui->radioButtonMode0->isChecked())
      parameter->Mode = (GuardMode)0;}
  if (ui->radioButtonMode1->isChecked())
      parameter->Mode = (GuardMode)1;}

  // 8, Index, integer combo
  parameter->Index = ui->comboBoxIndex->currentIndex();

  // 9, Title, Qt string combo
  parameter->Title = ui->comboBoxTitle->currentText();

  // 10, Kt_Name, legacy placeholder
  parameter->Kt_Name = ui->comboBoxKtName->currentText().toLocal8Bit().constData();

  // 11, Text_Value, local string conversion
  parameter->Text_Value = dialogMore->lineEditTextValue->text().toLocal8Bit().constData();

  // 12, No_Action, zero controls,NO ACTION, QSpinBox,0

  // 13, Unsupported, unknown Qt control,NO ACTION, QDial (Not Support),1

  // 14, Plain_Text, Qt text
  parameter->Plain_Text = ui->lineEditPlainText->text();

  // 15, Text_List, legacy string list
  parameter->Text_List[1] = ui->lineEditTextList0->text().toLocal8Bit().constData();
  parameter->Text_List[2] = ui->lineEditTextList1->text().toLocal8Bit().constData();

  // 16, Numbers, integer list
  parameter->Numbers[0] = ui->spinBoxNumbers0->value();
  parameter->Numbers[1] = ui->spinBoxNumbers1->value();

  // 17, Enabled, single checkbox
  parameter->Enabled = ui->checkBoxEnabled->isChecked();

  // 18, Push, directional no action,NO ACTION, QPushButton (Not Support),1

  // clang-format on
